name: Chaplain
overview: The role of a chaplain is rooted in faithfully proclaiming the doctrine given by God, as Jesus emphasized that His teaching is not His own but from the One who sent Him. This ministry involves sharing the gospel message of God's love and the gift of eternal life through His Son, ensuring believers remain grounded in Christ rather than being led astray by worldly philosophies or human traditions. Chaplains serve as spiritual guides who safeguard the truth of Christ's message, offering hope and eternal life to those they minister to.
